X-02 Admin forgot password

Bangla name: অ্যাডমিন পাসওয়ার্ড ভুলে যাওয়া

← 60 · Cross-cutting · Contents · Open queries

1. Name and purpose

Admin forgot password. Lets a staff member who forgot the password set a new one after proving control of the phone with an SMS code. The new password is written straight into the Admin Cognito pool by the Admin service and also sent to the phone by SMS.

2. Trigger and actor

Item Value
Actor Staff member with an Admin-pool account, not signed in
Client and screen Admin portal, link on the login page → ForgotPasswordComponent (route /auth/forgot-password, also shown as a dialog from the login page)
Cognito pool Admin
Role / program scope None (anonymous)

3. Business flow

  1. The staff member enters the 10-digit phone number.
  2. The portal sends an SMS code through the Serverless API (same call as login, X-01).
  3. The staff member enters the code; the Serverless API verifies it and returns the user's id.
  4. The staff member enters and confirms the new password (minimum 8 characters, upper, lower, digit, one of !@#$%^&*).
  5. The portal sends user id and password to the Admin service, which sets the password, signs the user out everywhere, and sends an SMS that contains the new password. The portal returns to the login page after 2 seconds.
  6. "Resend" on this screen does something different: it calls Cognito's own forgot-password flow with delivery by email.

4. Technical flow

# From → To Hop What happens
1 Admin portal → Serverless POST …/admin/login-2fa-send-otp [HTTP, static key] Same as X-01 step 1
2 Admin portal → Serverless POST …/admin/login-2fa-verify-otp [HTTP, static key] On sms_otp_verified_successfully the portal keeps response.user_id
3 Admin portal → Admin POST /admin/api/v1/admin-users/set-forget-password [HTTP, no token] ([AllowAnonymous]; the portal's auth interceptor skips this URL) Body { userId, password }
4 Admin service → Cognito (Admin pool) AWS SDK with static keys AdminGetUser(userId) to read phone_number, AdminUserGlobalSignOut, AdminSetUserPassword(Permanent = true)
5 Admin service → Notification service Notification:Endpoint [HTTP, static key] SMS "Your password has been changed successfully.New Password is …"
6 Admin service → database — Activity log row AdminUser / PasswordResetCompleted (X-24)
R (Resend) Admin portal → Cognito Amplify Auth.forgotPassword(phone, { DeliveryMedium: 'EMAIL' }) Cognito sends its own code by email; this screen never submits that code (confirmForgotPassword is not called)

5. Components

Kind Component
Client Admin portal ForgotPasswordComponent, CognitoService.submitPassword()
External Serverless API (OTP), Notification service (SMS) [UNCONFIRMED: Q-05]
Service Admin: AdminUsersController.ForgetSetPasswordAsync → AdminUserManager → AdminUserProvider
AWS Cognito Admin pool
Data etp activity log table (X-24)

6. API contracts

Method Path Auth Request DTO Response Main errors
POST /admin/api/v1/admin-users/set-forget-password none ([AllowAnonymous]) AdminForgetSetPassword { UserId, Password } 200 with body 200 400 ArgumentException (Cognito error text, e.g. password policy)
GET /admin/api/v1/admin-users/forget-password?phoneNo= none ([AllowAnonymous]) query phoneNo true / false — (errors are swallowed and return false)
POST {serverless}/admin/login-2fa-send-otp, …/verify-otp static key see X-01 { status_message, user_id } invalid_otp

GET forget-password is not called by the current portal (CognitoService.sendOtp() exists but has no caller); it is listed because it is reachable: it runs Cognito AdminResetUserPassword for the account with that phone number.

// POST /admin/api/v1/admin-users/set-forget-password
{ "userId": "3f6c2a8e-0000-4000-8000-000000000001", "password": "N3w!Passw0rd" }

// 200
200

// 400 when Cognito rejects the password
{ "status": 400, "title": "Password did not conform with policy: Password must have symbol characters" }

The 400 title is the Cognito exception message passed through ArgumentException; the example text is illustrative of that shape, the exact wording comes from Cognito.

7. Data and side effects

  • Cognito: password replaced (permanent), all sessions of the user revoked (AdminUserGlobalSignOut).
  • SMS with the new password in clear text, through the Notification service.
  • Activity log entry PasswordResetCompleted with entity id = user id.
  • GET forget-password (if called): Cognito marks the user RESET_REQUIRED and sends Cognito's own code; activity log entry PasswordResetRequested with the phone number as entity id.

9. Handover notes

  1. The backend does not check the OTP. set-forget-password is anonymous and trusts the userId in the body. The OTP is verified only between the browser and the Serverless API. Any caller who knows or guesses an admin's Cognito user id (the sub, or the username, which is the phone number) can set that admin's password. The local Postman collection demonstrates it ("Set known password (set-forget-password)"). Whether something in front of the service (API Gateway) blocks this route is not in the repos [UNCONFIRMED: Q-04].
  2. Passwords travel by SMS. The new password is sent back in clear text. The same pattern is used when accounts are created and when an admin resets someone's password (X-05).
  3. "Resend" is inconsistent. It starts Cognito's email-based flow, whose code this screen cannot accept. In practice the user has to start again with "Send OTP".
  4. GET forget-password is an unused but open endpoint that can force any admin account into RESET_REQUIRED (it needs only the phone number). Candidate for removal; listed in X-18.
  5. Response body. Both admin-user write endpoints return the literal number 200 as the body (Ok(200)), not an object.

11. Developer test guide

Local testability: Partial. The local OTP stub does not return user_id, so the browser flow stops at "User ID and password are required." The backend endpoint itself works against Floci. SMS is sent to the dummy Notification:Endpoint (https://notification.invalid/, scripts/user-secrets.example.json), so the SMS step fails and the endpoint returns 400 after the password has already been changed.

Emulator Not applicable
